claims.claim: Battery is new, holds charge for 8 hours. Never repaired.
claims.evidence: The witness report only shows two solar panels mounted side-by-side; no battery is shown, and no test/charge-duration evidence is visible.

claims.claim: Izutech solar energy specialize in all solar equipment such as inverter, panels, charge...
claims.evidence: No inverter/charge controller/battery is shown in the witness photos; only solar panels are described.

risks.risk: Unknown wattage/rating (W) per panel, which strongly affects value and suitability for your system.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the panel label showing brand, model, and wattage (W) for each panel.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic used solar panels with unknown rating (worst-case value for lower/uncertain output).

risks.risk: Condition risk: possible glass damage, micro-cracks, delamination, or frame corrosion not captured in the provided description.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the full glass surface (corners and edges) plus frame/junction box area showing any chips/cracks/corrosion.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially damaged/unknown condition panels (worst-case used condition).

risks.risk: Electrical health risk: panels may be underperforming even if they look intact (no I-V curve/test shown).
risks.proof: A panel performance test (I-V curve or multimeter/solar tester reading) for each panel, captured on video.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not-verified performance (worst-case: reduced output).

risks.risk: Missing/unclear system components: the photos show panels only; inverter/charge controller/battery/mounting hardware may be absent.
risks.proof: A full set photo showing everything included in the sale (inverter/charge controller/battery/mounting rails/cables/MC4 connectors) laid out clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as panels-only package (no bundled electronics or battery).

risks.risk: Brand/model and serial/warranty not verifiable, affecting resale value and buyer confidence.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the serial number/warranty label on each panel (and any receipt/warranty card if available).
risks.if_unproven: Price as no-brand/unknown provenance used panels.

proof_requests: Send a close-up photo of the label on each panel showing brand, model, and wattage (W).
Send close-up photos of the glass (corners/edges) and the frame for any cracks, chips, scratches, or corrosion.
Send a photo of the junction box and the cable/connector type (e.g., MC4) and confirm it matches your installation.
Send a video or screenshot of a performance test (I-V curve or solar tester reading) for each panel.
Confirm what is included in the sale by sending a full “everything included” photo (panels only vs panels + battery + controller + inverter + mounting hardware).
If a battery is included, send the battery label (brand/model/capacity) and a test showing it holds charge for the stated duration.
response.reason: The witness report clearly identifies the item type as a set of two solar panel modules mounted side-by-side, so it can be priced at worst-case for unknown rating and unverified condition. Seller statements about a battery cannot be verified from the shown item.
